policy.dedup: Deduplicate one presentation effect per semantic event and target. Global and per-card subscriptions route through the same key.
policy.no_rules: No gameplay mutation, target selection, RNG draw, damage calculation, status duration update or awaiting VFX completion.
policy.multiplayer: Owner/target stable entity IDs and authoritative event order. Local cosmetic variation uses event hash, never gameplay RNG.
policy.death: Cancel pending target-bound VFX on freed nodes; owner death clears own domain and audio. Revive does not restore domain without fresh rules event. Same-enemy-entity revival rebinds bite-mark UI from its preserved authoritative state.
policy.selection_cancel: Zero selection or cancelled invalid selection has no successful transfer/conversion cue. UI hover can use an uncommitted preview only.
policy.capacity: Respect actual hand-entry/selection events; no fake cards when hand is full. Replayed effects use same paid X/target snapshot.
policy.layering: Ground -20, rear ambient -10, character 0, front contact 20..30, status UI in its own CanvasLayer. Foreground near arm stays above braids independently.
policy.audio: sfx IDs resolved by ../audio/manifest.json; persistent loops do not restart sound on each visual loop. Group/multihit cues are rate-limited cosmetics.
policy.speed: Read presentation time scale; fast/skip mode may shorten or omit effects without changing rules. Never delay enemy action opportunity bookkeeping.
policy.flashes: No full-screen flash, no additive overdraw requirement; native premultiplied imports must use correct alpha. Straight-alpha PNG is authoritative.
policy.unsupported_unknown_source: Preserve unknown enemy behavior under domain; record unsupported source separately, never suppress because its VFX looks similar.

global_rule_cues.guard: each actual played Attack or ThunderSpell only; before its damage; replay excluded
per actual ordinary-attack segment; group packet counts once for mechanics
one persistent owner instance while domain positive; restart only after actual death/revive re-entry
known eligible source actually suppressed; unknown source preserved; aggregate surviving owners
purify before exhaust then replacement draw; all from actual card events
actual enabled status; no recursive rules execution in VFX
one small owner accent per confirmed batch; no anatomy morph; actual cards remain same entities
remove persistent visual by entity identity; not on same-entity revive
reason=owner_death stops owner-local loops and pending presentation, not authoritative bite-mark data; reason=battle_end clears all visuals
